user.title: Connect Home Assistant to Logfire
user.description: Use a dedicated project write token. Admin and read tokens are not required.

data_description.token: Create this in Logfire project settings under Write Tokens.
data_description.service_name: Name shown in Logfire's Services view.
data_description.environment: Value for deployment.environment.name, such as home or production.

reauth_confirm.title: Replace the Logfire write token
reauth_confirm.description: Logfire rejected the stored token. Enter a new project write token.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Logfire
reconfigure.description: Leave the write token blank to keep the existing token.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Logfire API. Check internet access and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Logfire rejected this write token. Create or copy a project write token and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Logfire project is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The Logfire write token was updated.

init.title: Choose Home Assistant telemetry
init.description: Only allowlisted scalar fields are exported. Full event bodies, service data, exception bodies, and user IDs are never sent.

data.export_system_logs: Export Home Assistant warning and error logs

data_description.include_domains: Leave empty to include every domain. Filters state events, metric entity counts, and targeted service calls.
data_description.exclude_entities: These entities are never included in state events, entity metrics, or targeted service calls.
data_description.queue_size: New events are intentionally dropped when this queue is full so telemetry cannot consume unbounded memory.
